title: Feature Branch
goal: A practitioner can read the feature branch artefact at a glance.

rubric.must: The named scenario is visibly identified and its primary subject is clearly shown.
The picture visibly uses the required standard diagram structure and connected elements.
A reader can visually follow the principal flow or relationship from beginning to end.
Key labels remain legible and attached to the correct visible elements.
Lines and symbols do not visually imply unintended connections.

ideal.notes: Updated 2026-09-14 against exemplar visual-eval/exemplars/gitgraph/horizontal/ideal.svg (sha256 2c8962e3f5d3). Exemplar coloured horizontal branches, compact commits, hollow merge commit and tag. Same four commits and merge history. Visually inspected at full size and across the case family; independent targets, not engine-output snapshots.
